Name: Matching Fishing Minigame
Author: PrimedPixel
Description:
Replaces the fishing minigame sprites to ones that better suit the fishing rods in-game.

[b][size=4]Note that the mod uses your current fishing level to determine which sprite to replace the rod with (unless the training rod option is enabled).[/size]


[/b][size=4]Training Rod (Any level, must be enabled)[/size]
Changes the handle and minigame colouring (must be enabled in settings)

[size=4]Bamboo Rod (Level 1)
[/size]Changes the handle colouring (can be disabled in settings)
[size=4]
Fiberglass Rod (Level 2 to 5)[/size]
Changes the handle and minigame colouring

[size=4]Iridium Rod (Level 6+)[/size]
Changes the handle and minigame colouring.
Note that the Iridium rod has two possibilities: "Very Purple", which is based entirely off the rod sprite itself, and "Purple", which uses an additional highlight colour from the iridium tools set (default). Whichever is used can be changed in settings.

[size=4]Mod Settings[/size]
This mod is configurable via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or by manually editing the "config.json" file in the mod directory.

[size=4]Installation Instructions[/size]
Download the latest version and copy the "[CP] Matching Fishing Minigame" folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is installed.
